title: Handley Page Halifax LW598
memorial_details: Single-stepped rectangular base surmounted by a rectangular sectioned marble pillar incorporating a sloping top face on which is mounted an engraved bronze plaque. At the top of the plaque is a Halifax bomber design with names and inscription below. A single-line border, scalloped at each corner, encloses the aircraft design, names and inscription and all are infilled with white paint. The whole memorial is enclosed by gravel within a kerbed area.
inscription: TO THE MEMORY OF / (6 NAMES) / MEMBERS OF 426 (CANADIAN) SQUADRON FROM LINTON on OUSE / WHO LOST THEIR LIVES IN A HALIFAX BOMBER WHICH CRASHED / NEAR THIS SITE AFTER RETURNING FROM OPERATIONS. / 4.00 a.m. 9th June, 1944. / 'They gave their today for our tomorrow'
